text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has received numerous complaints from residents regarding vehicles parking in close proximity to the northwest corner of Corby Avenue and McRoberts Avenue. On the north side of Corby Avenue, vehicles parking within the signed corner parking prohibition are impacting traffic operations and safety to pedestrians crossing. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing corner parking prohibition be increased to a stopping prohibition. The proposed parking amendment will deter parking in this area and improve traffic operations and safety for all road users.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Corby Avenue, between McRoberts Avenue and a point 13 metres west.
